decision: high-confidence orthology is accepted for this restricted 16-species mitochondrial locus set only

coordinate_bridge.note: Author residue numbering is not a fixed ungapped sequence index.

limitations: The decision applies only to the restricted vertebrate mitochondrial tRNA-Phe(GAA) locus set, not to all RF00005 sequences.
The broad RF00005 seed remains a heterogeneous structural family, not a single orthologous locus.
No species-tree-aware evolutionary analysis is included.
The subset conservation contrast is sensitive to coverage and taxon composition.
